en.name: Dimension Pair Link L
en.effect: Ritual Summon "Waso Gozen Linker" by sending face-up monsters from your field to the Graveyard whose total Levels equal 8 or more as material (you cannot use more monsters than necessary as material). Then, you can send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard. If you do, you can Special Summon 1 "Dimension Riletta" from your Graveyard to your field in face-up Defense Position.
